confronta quello che l'agente sa e dice: compares what the agent knows and says with what's really there. Orange outline with a clock: a file it read that then changed (by another agent or outside the session) without it reading it again, a stale memory. Dashed purple squares with a question mark: files it looked for, opened or mentioned that don't exist, invented paths; paler if someone created them later (it was an intention). On the right, its claims («tests pass», «I fixed X»…) compared with what it did in the same turn: grounded if a fact proves it, no evidence if nothing does, contradicted if the last outcome is a failure. The grounding index is the share of grounded claims. Click an item to go to that moment.
